title: Etgar Keret says his legacy is to help build the Israel his Holocaust-survivor parents 'dreamed of'
summary: François Picard is pleased to welcome Israeli writer and filmmaker Etgar Keret, author of "The Seven Good Years", joining us from Tel Aviv.
